fusions.name: Broadside Volley
fusions.desc: Fires 3 shots at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Cannon Run
fusions.desc: Fires a ball that deals 40 damage and explodes for 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Full Sail
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 6 tiles forward. You move 15% faster for 6 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Steady Heading
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
